sample_unit: ChatGPT-4 responses graded by 12 ASOPRS physicians

links.outcome: Reading level of ChatGPT-4 postoperative responses (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level)
links.effect: Flesch Reading Ease scores ranged from 28.9 to 50.2, with Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores ranging from grade 9.4 to 13.4 for reading level.
links.quote: Flesch Reading Ease scores ranged from 28.9 to 50.2, with Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level scores ranging from grade 9.4 to 13.4 for reading level.

links.outcome: Understandability and actionability of AI patient responses (PEMAT) and readability
links.effect: Average PEMAT understandability 91.67 ± 0.52%, while all 6 responses received an actionability score of 60%; reading grade level 9.4 to 13.4.
links.quote: The average Patient Education Materials Assessment Tool understandability score was 91.67 ± 0.52%, while all 6 responses received an actionability score of 60%.

screen.reason: Evaluates the accuracy, readability, understandability, and actionability of ChatGPT-4 responses to common postoperative patient concerns after blepharoplasty without testing a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
